name: mirage
text:
Your keys are still safe on GitHub. The export failed for one reason: the passphrase secret you set (KEYS_EXPORT_PASSPHRASE) is shorter than 16 characters. Both runs (Oct 28 and Oct 29) stopped with 'passphrase must be at least 16 characters'. It's already in the app (v1.0.92), so nothing new to install.

Steps:
1. On github.com, open tjshea90/novig > Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions. Open KEYS_EXPORT_PASSPHRASE, choose Update, and type a new passphrase of 16 or more characters. Three or four words with spaces works, for example 'purple tablet river 2026'. Write it down.
2. Open the Actions tab, pick 'Export my keys (encrypted)' on the left, then Run workflow > Run workflow. Wait for the green check (about 1 minute).
3. On the tablet, open Vigilant > Settings > Usage details & keys backup. In the box 'Export passphrase' type the same passphrase, then tap 'Bring my API keys back from GitHub'. It opens the file on the tablet and fills in every API that has no key yet. It needs the GitHub token to be saved in the app first.
4. The Novig trading and read keys are not part of this. Use Enable betting for those. The Novig management key was never stored on GitHub, so you enter the new one by hand.

Tell me when step 2 is green or if the app says anything odd, and I'll check it.
